description: This file contains utility classes and functions for parsing Python files into ASTs, finding Python files in directories, and extracting file information from code objects. It is part of the 'astor' library for Python AST manipulation.

classes.name: CodeToAst
classes.description: A utility class for parsing Python files into ASTs, caching results, and extracting file and line information from code objects.

methods.name: find_py_files
methods.description: Returns all Python files in a source directory, optionally ignoring paths containing a specific string.

methods.name: parse_file
methods.description: Parses a Python file into an AST.

methods.name: get_file_info
methods.description: Retrieves the filename and line number from a code object.
